Hourglass.description: Bust and hips are balanced, with a clearly defined waist.
avoid_fits: Boxy, oversized shapes that hide the waist

Pear.description: Hips are wider than the bust and shoulders.
recommended_fits: Dark bottoms paired with brighter tops
avoid_fits: Skinny fits that draw attention to the hips

Apple.description: Fuller midsection with a less defined waist.

Rectangle.description: Bust, waist, and hips are similar in width, with minimal curve definition.

Inverted Triangle.description: Shoulders and bust are broader than the hips.
